jobs.alt: Pink Blur runs in side profile after the dark green getaway car, falling behind despite her effort.
jobs.context: For an instant she saw the driver through the open side window. He saw her too. His head jerked forward and the car gathered speed. She followed it into the lane. Jenny could see his face getting smaller. “Stop!”
